headline: Equinor Signs 18-Year Natural Gas Supply Deal With Germany's VNG
summary: Norway's Equinor has signed an 18-year natural gas supply agreement with German energy firm VNG. Equinor will supply up to 15.3 TWh per year starting in 2027 through 2044.
why: Equinor is Norway's state-controlled energy company and a major supplier of natural gas to continental European utilities.

impacts.name: Equinor
impacts.why: Equinor secured a long-term supply contract for up to 15.3 TWh of natural gas per year.
